title: Initial candidate-advance configuration
statement: For any Boolean words $w$ and $s$, the cleanup scan configuration at count zero, with candidate input $w$ and candidate word $s$, equals the canonical seam configuration whose state is $(0,\mathrm{false})$ and whose sole work tape stores $s$.
replaced:
The one-tape candidate-advance machine's starting scan configuration equals
the canonical word-seam configuration carrying the candidate on its single
tape.
